description: This script processes and analyzes test timing data for layout tests, providing functionalities to group and identify the fastest tests based on timing metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, load timing data, and invoke analysis functions.

methods.name: print_times
methods.description: Prints grouped timing data based on specified options.

methods.name: print_fastest
methods.description: Identifies and prints the fastest tests based on timing data and options.

methods.name: key_for
methods.description: Generates grouping keys for test paths based on forward or backward directory depth.

methods.name: times_by_key
methods.description: Aggregates timing data by generated keys.
